profileEvidence.summary: Active and athletic, Sussex Bulldogs formed part of a fanciers’ effort to revive an earlier Bulldog type. The association coordinated seven breeders through quarterly meetings, with a first annual show planned for 2008. Selection sought a sturdy, unexaggerated dog after more than two decades of breeding.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An active, athletic Bulldog type developed by Sussex fanciers through coordinated selection over many generations.
